meta.name: wowerpoint
meta.description: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Use for "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档一键变成可爱风演示文稿 PDF
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要把报告或文档快速变成可分享的演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Turn a document into a cute presentation PDF
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn reports or documents into shareable presentations

howto.what: 把一份文档变成 kawaii 风格的幻灯片 PDF,默认存到源文件旁(文件名加 -slides),生成期间打印 notebook 链接供你实时查看。若服务器环境变量齐全,还会上传并返回手机版分享链接,该链接是主要交付物。
howto.when: 当你提到 “Wowerpoint this”、“make a deck about <file>” 等说法,或要求把某份文档、报告做成幻灯片时触发。

howto.what_en: Turns one document into a kawaii slide-deck PDF via NotebookLM and saves it beside the source as <stem>-slides.pdf. If server env vars are set, it also uploads the deck and returns a phone share link.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say things like "Wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", or ask to turn a report into slides.
